title: Counterexamples and gap phenomena for derived delooping levels
summary: Guo and Igusa introduced the derived and sub-derived delooping levels as refinements of the delooping level and asked how these two invariants compare, whether the derived delooping level always coincides with the opposite big finitistic dimension, and, if not, how large their difference can be. We answer these questions. First, we prove that every Artin algebra $A$ satisfies $\operatorname{ddell} A\leq \operatorname{sub-ddell} A$.
